tasks.label: Gwire: stop debug sessions (macOS)
args:
set -e
profile="$1/.vscode/chrome-local-debug-profile"
case "${VSCODE_PID:-}" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*)
    ancestor="$$"
    VSCODE_PID=""
    for step in {1..30}; do
      [ "$ancestor" -gt 1 ] || break
      command=$(ps -p "$ancestor" -o command=) || break
      case "$command" in
        *'/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron'|*'/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron '*)
          VSCODE_PID="$ancestor"
          break
          ;;
      esac
      ancestor=$(ps -p "$ancestor" -o ppid= | tr -d ' ') || break
      case "$ancestor" in ''|*[!0-9]*) break ;; esac
    done
    if [ -z "$VSCODE_PID" ]; then
      echo "Run this task from VS Code; its process could not be identified."
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;
esac
belongs_to_vscode() {
  ancestor="$1"
  for step in {1..30}; do
    [ "$ancestor" = "$VSCODE_PID" ] && return 0
    [ "$ancestor" -gt 1 ] || return 1
    ancestor=$(ps -p "$ancestor" -o ppid= | tr -d ' ') || return 1
    case "$ancestor" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  done
  return 1
}
is_debug_chrome() {
  [[ "$1" == '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome '* ]] &&
    { [[ "$1" == *"--user-data-dir=$profile "* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"--user-data-dir=$profile" ]]; }
}
targets=()
snapshot=$(ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command=)
while read -r pid parent command; do
  [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$parent" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  [ "$pid" != "$$" ] || continue
  if is_debug_chrome "$command"; then
    targets+=("$pid")
  elif [[ "${command%% *}" == */dotnet && "$command" == *'/.vswebassemblybridge/Microsoft.Diagnostics.BrowserDebugHost.dll '* ]] &&
       [[ "$command" =~ --OwnerPid[[:space:]]+([0-9]+) ]] &&
       belongs_to_vscode "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; then
    targets+=("$pid")
  elif [[ "$command" == '/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron '* ||
          "$command" == '/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Frameworks/Code Helper.app/Contents/MacOS/Code Helper '* ]] &&
       [[ "$command" == *'/out/bootstrap-fork ms-dotnettools.monovsdbg_wasm '* ||
          "$command" == *'/out/bootstrap-fork ms-vscode.pwa-chrome '* ]] &&
       belongs_to_vscode "$pid"; then
    targets+=("$pid")
  fi
done <<< "$snapshot"
if [ "${#targets[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No matching debug processes were found."
fi
for pid in "${targets[@]}"; do
  if kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Stopping debug process $pid."; fi
done
for pid in "${targets[@]}"; do
  for attempt in {1..30}; do
    kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 0.1
  done
  if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Debug process $pid is still running; profile locks were left untouched."
    exit 1
  fi
done
current_commands=$(ps -axo command=)
while read -r command; do
  if is_debug_chrome "$command"; then
    echo "The debug browser is still running; profile locks were left untouched."
    exit 1
  fi
done <<< "$current_commands"
rm -f -- "$profile/SingletonLock" "$profile/code.lock"
echo "Debug process cleanup completed."
